kpis.label: Average chain throughput, all load generators running
kpis.method: Chain transactions per block-timestamp second, summed over the 2394-s window when every load generator was in its mixed phase and divided by its length.

kpis.label: Best 60 seconds, all load generators running
kpis.method: Highest mean chain tx/s over any 60 consecutive seconds inside the all-generators window (aggregate.py best_window_mean).

kpis.label: Transactions landed over the whole blast
kpis.method: Sum of tx_count over every block the load generators saw during the blast, own and foreign transactions alike.

kpis.label: Blocks per second
kpis.method: Chain blocks whose timestamp falls in the merged mixed window, divided by its length (aggregate.py landed.capacity.blocks_per_sec over the same window).

kpis.label: Time to land, median
kpis.method: Block timestamp minus submit time over every landed own transaction in the blast, from the load generators' merged latency histograms (aggregate.py merge_latency), in seconds.

kpis.label: Time to land, p95
kpis.method: Block timestamp minus submit time over every landed own transaction in the blast, from the load generators' merged latency histograms (aggregate.py merge_latency), in seconds.

kpis.label: Commit latency, p95
kpis.method: For each healthy validator, the nearest-rank p95 over the merged mixed window of its 15-s histogram_quantile(0.95) commit-latency series; reported as the range over validators.

kpis.label: Execution time per consensus output
kpis.method: For each healthy validator, the nearest-rank median over the merged mixed window of its 15-s mean execution-duration series; reported as the range over validators.

kpis.label: Write throughput, p95, busiest validator
kpis.method: Nearest-rank p95 of the 60-s mean write-byte rate over the merged mixed window for each healthy validator; the highest (bench-validator-08) is reported.

kpis.label: Write operations, p95, busiest validator
kpis.method: Nearest-rank p95 of the 60-s mean write-operation rate over the merged mixed window for each healthy validator; the highest (bench-validator-10) is reported.

kpis.label: CPU, p95, busiest validator
kpis.method: Nearest-rank p95 of the 60-s CPU utilisation over the merged mixed window for each healthy validator; the highest (bench-validator-09) is reported.

kpis.label: Node resident memory, p95, busiest validator
kpis.method: Nearest-rank p95 of the 60-s telcoin process resident memory over the merged mixed window for each healthy validator; the highest (bench-validator-10) is reported.

kpis.label: IO pressure, highest reading, range over validators
kpis.method: For each healthy validator, the highest 10-s 'some' IO pressure reading the on-node sampler logged inside the merged mixed window; reported as the range over validators.
